title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet, 49-Inch Solid Brass, Assorted Free Standing Accessories, , Allied Brass
description:

Highlights:
- More hanging room for daily routines—4 pivoting swing arms let you spread out towels and rotate them for access
- No wall mounting required—freestanding, floor-standing design sets up anywhere
- Reduced wobble—large, weighted base helps prevent tipping
- Built to last in humid spaces—solid brass construction is made to resist rust and corrosion
- Easy to coordinate—part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options

- Assembled in the USA
